actions.title: Review Content Security Policy
actions.remediation: Evaluate a restrictive Content Security Policy in report-only mode before enforcing it. Retain output encoding as the primary protection.

citations.excerpt: Assess a restrictive Content Security Policy as a secondary browser control. Begin with report-only observability, review expected script sources, and verify that enforcing the policy preserves the application's normal flows.
Serve the intended Content-Type. Review whether the X-Content-Type-Options header is set to nosniff where appropriate.

Use context-appropriate output encoding through the application's templates. Review paths that deliberately render rich HTML and apply an allowlist sanitizer at those boundaries. A capture cannot establish whether template escaping is correct.
